decision_conditions:
Condition : 1 - The London Borough of Hounslow as the Local Planning Authority hereby certify that on the 5th November 2004 the matter described above is lawful within the meaning of section 191 and 192 of the Town and Country Planning Act 1990 for the following reasons:

The proposed outbuilding that would be located more than 5m from the dwellinghouse as extended with a gabled roof with a ridge height of 3.5m above the existing ground level, which would not take the total area of outbuilding and extension coverage to more than 50% of the dwellings curtilage, constitutes permitted development as defined by Schedule 2, Part 1, Class E of the Town and Country Planning (General Permitted Development) Order 1995 (as amended) and therefore does not require planning permission.


INFORMATIVE 

The detached outbuilding hereby found to be lawful shall only be used for a purpose incidental to the enjoyment of the dwellinghouse at 131 Woodlawn Gardens and for no other purpose (i.e. it shall not be used as a bedroom, living room, office or separate habitable unit).
description: Certificate of Lawfulness for the proposed erection of a single storey outbuilding for use as a garage in rear garden of existing dwellinghouse.
